{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(data.dtypes)
print(data.head())

# Confirm the sentinel value for age
print("\nNumber of rows with customer_age == -1:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("\nNumber of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print("\nNumber of refunded orders:", len(refunded))

# Filter data: exclude QA orders, refunded orders, and missing age data
filtered_data = data[
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (data['status'] == 'completed') &
    (data['customer_age'] != -1)
]

# Now compute the mean age of customers who converted
mean_age_converted = filtered_data[filtered_data['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"\nMean age of customers who converted: {mean_age_converted}")"}
